exposure: respiratory modality used (invasive respiratory support, non-invasive respiratory support)
outcome: short term morbidities (nasal trauma, sepsis, septic shock, disseminated intravascular coagulation, necrotising enterocolitis, intraventricular haemorrhage)
cohort: The study included 200 preterm newborns admitted to the neonatology department with respiratory distress in a hospital in India.
finding: Invasive respiratory support was associated with significantly higher rates of short-term morbidities, retinopathy of prematurity, and mortality compared to non-invasive support in preterm neonates with respiratory distress.
